question: In historical texts, Baji Rao I is popularly referred to as:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Baji Rao Ballal**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__
 __ 
• **Baji Rao I**, also known as **Baji Rao Ballal**, was a prominent figure in Indian history and a celebrated general of the Maratha Empire. 
• Baji Rao I served as the **Peshwa (Prime Minister)** to Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj from **1720 to 1740**. His tenure marked the expansion of the Maratha Empire to its zenith. 
• He is often referred to as “Baji Rao Ballal” in historical texts and folklore, emphasizing his valiant military campaigns and leadership skills. 
• Under his leadership, the Marathas achieved remarkable victories against the Mughals and other adversaries, establishing dominance across most of India. 
• He is renowned for his swift and innovative military strategies, earning him the title of the "Napoleon of India" by later historians. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
 __ 
• **About Baji Rao I:** 
• Baji Rao I was born on **18 August 1700** in Chhatrapati Shivaji's lineage and became the Peshwa at the young age of 20. 
• He was instrumental in expanding the Maratha Empire beyond the Deccan plateau, reaching as far as Delhi and the Gangetic plains. 
• His political and military strategies were visionary and aimed at creating a unified Hindu empire. 
• **Military Achievements:** 
• Baji Rao I never lost a battle in his 20-year career as a military leader, showcasing his exceptional skills on the battlefield. 
• Key victories include the **Battle of Palkhed (1728)**, where he defeated the Nizam of Hyderabad, and other significant campaigns against the Mughals and the Portuguese. 
• **Personal Life:** 
• Baji Rao was married to Kashibai and later to Mastani, a relationship that has been immortalized in Indian folklore and cinema. 
• He passed away on **28 April 1740**, at the age of 39, in Raverkhedi (present-day Madhya Pradesh). 
• **Legacy:** 
• Baji Rao I is remembered as one of the greatest warriors in Indian history, whose leadership solidified the Maratha Empire's dominance. 
• Numerous monuments and cultural depictions, including movies and literature, have been dedicated to his memory. 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**
 
• **Other Options Explained:** 
• **Peshwa Vishwajeet:** This title is not historically associated with Baji Rao I. 
• **Balaji Rao:** Balaji Baji Rao (commonly known as Nana Saheb) was Baji Rao I's son and not the same person. 
• **Shahu's Commander:** While Baji Rao I served under Chhatrapati Shahu, this is not the title by which he is popularly referred to in historical texts. 
• **Significance in Indian History:** 
• Baji Rao I played a crucial role in establishing the Marathas as a dominant power after the decline of the Mughal Empire. 
• His campaigns and governance laid the foundation for future Maratha leaders to build upon. 
4f
